FAQ

Practical questions before you go.

How strenuous are the hikes?

Most days are moderate, with optional harder spurs and clear alternatives.

Are departures guaranteed?

Trips run with six guests. We confirm status before final payment is due.

Can dietary needs be accommodated?

Yes. We collect preferences before departure and plan lodge meals accordingly.
